dish_drainer_door.notes: Same two widths and the same suffix 61 as H.48, H.60 and H.72 - four families agreeing, which is the longest run of agreement anywhere in this chapter. It gains a shelf the shorter families do not print.

dish_drainer_compound_2_folding.description: Dish-drainer unit with horizontally folding doors - 1 door - 1 door - 2 shelves - 2 stainless steel racks with drip tray - interior Valencia handle - no Push-pull device
interior_confirmed: 2 stainless steel racks with drip tray
dish_drainer_compound_2_folding.notes: TWO RACKS, ONE PER MODULE - and that is why this position does NOT carry the rule the other compound dish-drainers carry. H.36, H.48 and H.60 all print 'In compound wall units, the dish-drainer rack is fitted in the widest unit' beside a position with ONE rack; here there are two, so there is nothing to place and the sentence is absent. The rule and its absence agree.
